description: Light Lab: Laszlo's stateful light memory, shown on one leaf. Every surface texel (an anchor) remembers its light: a soft-sun visibility (the real 0.53 degree solar disk) and the indirect light from sky, bounces between leaf, twig and ground, and light transmitted through the leaf. The memory is path-traced progressively in a Web Worker, converges, then sleeps; the renderer samples it per pixel, so frame rate and light update rate are decoupled. Move the date/time slider and the memory re-converges from its previous state; drag the upper leaf and only the anchors whose light actually changes wake up. Fully offline: three.js is bundled, no network.
author: prackoreal
